_help: Text for the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use pages. Have these reviewed by the client's legal adviser before publishing. Each section has a heading and one or more paragraphs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Kommz Hub Ltd collects through this website and how we use it.

sections.heading: Who we are
text: Kommz Hub Ltd is a creative communications agency based in Kigali, Rwanda. For any question about this policy, contact us through the form on our contact page.

sections.heading: What we collect
text: When you send an enquiry or booking request, we receive the details you type into the form: your name, email address, and any phone number, organisation, project description, budget or timeline you choose to share.
We do not use advertising trackers or analytics cookies on this website.

sections.heading: How we use it
text: We use your details only to reply to your enquiry and to discuss the work you asked about. We do not sell or rent your information to anyone.

sections.heading: Services that help run this site
text: Form messages are delivered to our inbox by FormSubmit (formsubmit.co). Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. These providers process the minimum technical data needed to deliver their service, under their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
text: We keep enquiry emails for as long as needed to respond and to manage any work that follows, then delete them when they are no longer needed.

sections.heading: Your rights
text: You can ask us to show, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by contacting us. We will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: Changes
text: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it last changed.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using this website you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: About this website
text: This website is operated by Kommz Hub Ltd, Kigali, Rwanda. It presents our services, our work and The Up Close podcast.

sections.heading: Content and ownership
text: Text, images, videos, logos and other material on this website belong to Kommz Hub Ltd or to the clients and partners who have allowed us to show them. You may not copy, reuse or republish this material without written permission.

sections.heading: Client work
text: Projects shown in Our Work are displayed with the permission of the clients involved. Their names and brands remain their property.

sections.heading: Accuracy
text: We work to keep the information on this website accurate and up to date, but it is provided for general information and may change without notice.

sections.heading: Links to other websites
text: This website links to other sites, such as YouTube, Spotify and social media platforms. We are not responsible for the content or practices of those sites.

sections.heading: Enquiries
text: Sending an enquiry through this website does not create a contract. Any work we agree to do is covered by a separate written agreement.

sections.heading: Governing law
text: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Rwanda.
